summary: Tested DiabetesMealsPage dropdown selectors for Dietary Preference, Meal Type, and Cuisine. All dropdown indicators are visible after completing the onboarding flow (mood, diabetes type, dietary pref, meal type, cuisine). Each dropdown badge displays a RefreshCw icon indicating it is clickable. Clicking the Meal Type dropdown opens a menu with Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner options. The implementation matches ChatPage's dropdown behavior.
